description: rulescope catalog: split a data stream name (type-dataset-namespace) into its parts. A name that doesn't fit is kept with rulescope.parse_error, so one odd name can't fail a sync.

set.description: When this sync wrote the pair. Stale cleanup keeps pairs written since a sync started.

script.description: Workflow templates render missing values as empty strings; numeric fields reject them.
script.source: Map r = ctx.rulescope?.rule; if (r != null) { for (String k : ['interval_s', 'lookback_s', 'rule_id', 'name', 'type']) { if (r.get(k) instanceof String && ((String) r.get(k)).trim() == '') { r.remove(k); } } }
if (ctx.data_stream.namespace.contains('-')) { throw new IllegalArgumentException('data stream name has more than three parts: ' + ctx.data_stream.name); }
